Resolves #19647

The GitHub copy of the multi-window post now opens the way the operator published it on Medium (https://tobiasuhlig.medium.com/multi-window-web-apps-without-syncing-state-4b57e2b6722b):
- the title and lede are written for readers new to Neo.mjs;
- the disclosure line names Grace as author, Tobias Uhlig as editor and the cross-family review;
- the cover is labelled an AI-generated illustration, in an italic caption and in its alt text.

The `blog.json` name follows the H1. The slug and route are unchanged.

This copy matters today because at least one large subreddit refuses Medium links, so the post is shared there from GitHub.

Evidence: L2 (static copy comparison plus the existing SEO spec) → L2 required (docs only; no runtime surface).

Micro-review eligible: copy — four opening lines plus one `blog.json` name, checked character by character against the live Medium text.
